metadata.description: Create a new payment link in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Create a new payment link in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify various attributes for the payment link, such as accepted payment methods, currency, and additional form fields. The payment link can be configured for one-time use and can also collect shipping and billing addresses. This operation requires a valid JSON request body. Some defaults will be applied if no value provided.

acceptedPaymentMethods.label: Accepted Payment Methods
acceptedPaymentMethods.description: An array of accepted payment methods for the payment link. Valid values include 'CREDIT_OR_DEBIT_CARD', 'ACH', 'SEPA', 'BACS', and 'PADS'.

additionalFormFields.label: Additional Form Fields
additionalFormFields.description: An array of PaymentLinkFormField objects representing additional form fields to be included in the payment link.

automatedSalesTaxEnabled.label: Automated Sales Tax Enabled
automatedSalesTaxEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether automated sales tax is enabled.

businessUnitId.label: Business Unit Id
businessUnitId.description: A string representing the business unit ID associated with the payment link.

collectFullBillingAddress.label: Collect Full Billing Address
collectFullBillingAddress.description: A boolean indicating whether to collect the full billing address during checkout.

collectShippingAddress.label: Collect Shipping Address
collectShippingAddress.description: A boolean indicating whether the shipping address should be collected during checkout.

currencyCode.label: Currency Code
currencyCode.description: The currency code for the payment, represented as a string.

createNewDealOnPurchase.label: Create New Deal On Purchase
createNewDealOnPurchase.description: A boolean indicating whether a new deal should be created in HubSpot upon a purchase. Required field.

pipelineStageId.label: Pipeline Stage Id
pipelineStageId.description: The identifier for the pipeline stage where the new deal will be placed. This is a string value.

descriptionHtml.label: Description Html
descriptionHtml.description: A string containing the HTML description of the payment link.

label.label: Label
label.description: A descriptive label for the discount. This is a string.

value.label: Value
value.description: The numerical value of the discount to be applied. This is a number.

valueType.label: Value Type
valueType.description: The type of discount value, which can either be 'FIXED' or 'PERCENT'.

discountCodeEnabled.label: Discount Code Enabled
discountCodeEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether discount codes are enabled for the payment link.

discountObjectId.label: Discount Object Id
discountObjectId.description: A string representing the object ID of a discount associated with the payment link.

discountObjectIds.label: Discount Object Ids
discountObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of discount objects associated with the payment link.

domainId.label: Domain Id
domainId.description: The domain ID associated with the payment link, represented as a string.

enableDefaultCheckoutFees.label: Enable Default Checkout Fees
enableDefaultCheckoutFees.description: A boolean indicating whether default checkout fees are enabled.

feeObjectIds.label: Fee Object Ids
feeObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of fee objects associated with the payment link.

fees.label: Fees
fees.description: An array of FeeRequest objects, representing the fees to be applied to the payment link.

includeEmailInSuccessRedirect.label: Include Email In Success Redirect
includeEmailInSuccessRedirect.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the email in the success redirect URL.

isOneTimeUseEnabled.label: Is One Time Use Enabled
isOneTimeUseEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether the payment link is enabled for one-time use.

lineItemObjectIds.label: Line Item Object Ids
lineItemObjectIds.description: An array of line item object IDs associated with the payment link, each represented as a string.

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: An array of line items, which can be custom, from a product, or cloned, as defined by their respective schemas.

paymentLinkName.label: Payment Link Name
paymentLinkName.description: The name of the payment link. It is a string value.

state.label: State
state.description: The state of the payment link, represented as a string. Valid values are 'ON' and 'OFF'.

storePaymentMethodAtCheckout.label: Store Payment Method At Checkout
storePaymentMethodAtCheckout.description: A boolean indicating whether to store the payment method at checkout.

successUrl.label: Success Url
successUrl.description: A string that defines the URL to redirect to upon successful payment.

taxObjectIds.label: Tax Object Ids
taxObjectIds.description: An array of string IDs representing tax objects associated with the payment link.

taxes.label: Taxes
taxes.description: An array of TaxRequest objects, each representing a tax associated with the payment link.
